result.note: Mainly an enforcement directive. Tested the legal status of nicotine pouches and the court's rejection of the duty-free immunity claim.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the Union health ministry ordered state governments to crack down on the illegal sale of nicotine pouches. Consider the following statements:
items: Nicotine pouches are unapproved and illegal under Indian drug laws.
An Indian court accepted the defence that airport duty-free shops are immune from domestic laws.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Nicotine pouches remain unapproved and illegal under Indian drug laws, even though they are sold online, in local shops and at duty-free outlets. Statement 2 is wrong because the court quashed the Adani Group's argument that its airport duty-free shops were immune from domestic laws. The federal drug advisory panel has also recommended a complete ban on approving any new nicotine formulations.
questions.source: Despite growing global popularity and availability via online channels, local shops, and duty-free outlets, nicotine pouches remain unapproved and illegal under Indian drug laws.
